{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are too slow to react to sentiment shifts, especially negative sentiment which causes excessive lag",
    "When sentiment turns negative, model forecasts remain above true prices for 10-15 days, showing significant lag",
    "Positive sentiment changes are better captured but model oversells the recovery, forecasting 2-4% below true values",
    "Mean reversion bias: model under-forecasts price rebounds by 1-3% when prices deviate far from sentiment-based levels",
    "Sentiment zero or near-zero values cause model to forecast prices at or near previous day's close, missing 1-2% daily drift",
    "When sentiment is strongly positive (1.0), model is too conservative, forecasting 1-3% below actual price increases",
    "Model fails to capture sentiment-induced volatility spikes, showing smoother forecasts than 2-5% daily price swings" ]
}
